ACME COMPONENTS, INC. 2026 Proxy Statement
The Annual Meeting of Shareholders will be held on June 12, 2026.
The record date for voting is April 30, 2026.
Proposal 1: Election of three directors. Board recommendation: FOR.
Proposal 2: Ratification of independent registered public accounting firm. Board recommendation: FOR.
Proposal 3: Advisory vote to approve executive compensation. Board recommendation: FOR.
No other matters are expected to be presented at the annual meeting.
